simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to פּוֹל (H6321) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.

simple.summary: פּוֹל (pôwl) means a bean (as plump) First listed occurrence: 2Sam 17 28.

definitions.full: H6321. pol מּוֺל noun [masculine] collective beans (Late Hebrew = Biblical Hebrew; Arabic ; Ethiopic מּוֺלָא ᵑ9 ); — 2Sam 17:28 ; Ezek 4:9 , ᵐ5 κύαμος .
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root meaning to be thick ;
